parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

parameters.name: QueueName
parameters.description:
The name of the queue that you want to delete.

You can call the [ListQueues](~~92176~~) operation to query the name of the queue.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc delete-queue --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --queue-name workq --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
